'''Sheel Mafeen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Poet/Legends|poetess]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], she was a fighter of the [[Whiplash]] resistance movement and member of the [[Whiplash Council]]. She was a good friend of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|Prefect]] [[Pol Haus]], also a member of Whiplash, with whom she shared a flirtatious relationship. After a [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|failed attack]] on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's Villa|villa]] by Whiplash which killed most of the Whiplash Council and operatives, Mafeen and Haus were one of the few remaining Whiplash Council members.
